1password-beta on Omarchy

The bleeding-edge preview channel of 1Password's password manager, ahead of the stable release.

Package data synced 2026-10-23 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install 1password-beta on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add 1password-beta. It is a 209 MB download (609 MB installed), version 8.12.44_25.BETA-1, licensed LicenseRef-1Password-Proprietary. Password manager and secure wallet. Same 1Password subscription plans as the stable app.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install 1password-beta on Omarchy

1password-beta packages the pre-release beta build of the 1Password desktop app, so users can try new features and fixes before they reach the stable channel. It is the same encrypted password, passkey, and secrets vault as regular 1Password, just built from a newer, less-tested release track.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add 1password-beta
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 8.12.44_25.BETA-1:
    pacman -Qi 1password-beta

Open and use 1password-beta

1password-beta is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql 1password-beta | grep applications

1password-beta requirements and compatibility

  • a 1Password account (paid subscription) to store and sync vault data
  • network access to sync vaults
  • tolerance for pre-release bugs since this is the beta channel

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • hicolor-icon-theme
  • libgtk-3.so
  • nss
  • xdg-utils

Pricing and license

Same 1Password subscription plans as the stable app. License: LicenseRef-1Password-Proprietary.

Uninstall 1password-beta

omarchy pkg drop 1password-beta

Frequently asked questions

How do I install 1password-beta on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add 1password-beta. The download is 209 MB and it takes 609 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is 1password-beta free?

Same 1Password subscription plans as the stable app. The package is licensed LicenseRef-1Password-Proprietary.

How do I uninstall 1password-beta?

Run omarchy pkg drop 1password-beta. It removes the package from your system.

What does 1password-beta depend on?

The package declares 4 dependencies: hicolor-icon-theme, libgtk-3.so, nss, xdg-utils. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is 1password-beta a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for 1password-beta.

Is 1password-beta in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as 1password-beta (version 8.12.44_25.BETA-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. 1Password makes it. Project site: https://1password.com.
